description.value: King Taps is a multi-level craft beer bar and restaurant situated on the North Vancouver waterfront at Lonsdale Quay, with a patio overlooking Burrard Inlet. The bar pours regional wines and locally-sourced rotating taps alongside an Italian-inspired food menu featuring handmade pizzas and shareable plates. Its waterfront location makes it a natural refuelling stop for cyclists arriving via the SeaBus or riding the North Shore seawall.
